name: Dwarven Plate

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +2 AC; when something moves you against your will along the ground, you can cut the distance by up to 10 ft.
text: While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class. In addition, if an effect moves you against your will along the ground, you can take a Reaction to reduce the distance you are moved by up to 10 feet.
